rootRegistrarDerivation.formula: deriveProgramAddress({ programAddress: NAME_SERVICE_PROGRAM, seed: raw root-name bytes }) — NO sha256 and NO parent in the seed (the ONE exception to the domain rule sha256(parent‖name))
rootRegistrarDerivation.method: offline exact-match inversion against the CLI's derive outputs (through-cli binary executed locally; SDK deriveProgramAddress verified against prior live-recovered domain derivations)
rootRegistrarDerivation.domainCrossCheck: CLI `nameservice derive-domain-account <id-root> alice` = ta43m6gvFeVOZUGUeVliKI-zTmvCawMbE4tCYgDoKd1TGY = our domainAccountAddress() byte-exact

recoveredFacts.officialNamespace: .thru is the official registry root (initialize-registry default root name 'thru'); .id is a community root registrar (ThruScan) sharing the same official derivation formula

registrarSemantics.model: paid leases, not permanent ownership: initialize-registry(config seed 'config', treasurer token account, payment token mint, price_per_year u64); purchase-domain(name 1-64 chars, years u8 1-255, config, payer token account of registry mint; auto-generates lease+domain state proofs); renew-lease; claim-expired-domain
registrarSemantics.selfSigned: docs + CLI confirm authority = fee payer everywhere (matches AGENTS.md invariant)

recoveredFacts.nameServiceCorroboration: official docs confirm the command family and self-signed semantics our recovered formats assumed; ops delete-record / unregister-subdomain exist but their OPCODES stay unrecovered (no read need)
